name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Superior Sauna & Steam presents customized saunas that are unlike others and represents a wonderful blending of Infrared and Finnish sauna to provide the very best from both types of saunas at no excess expense and at the reach of your fingertips – any time at home.



And if some time ago saunas were limited to a specific design and capacity, nowadays any sauna is limited only to the imagination of the future owner. Innovative technology, finest quality materials and electronics, personalized design – you name it, the possibilities are endless! Everything comes together to make a perfect handcrafted custom sauna with double choice – traditional Finnish and Infrared sauna therapy.



Planners, consultants and experts will be at your disposal throughout the whole process of bringing the project to life to help build the perfect custom sauna to fit your choices and your dreams, so that you will be able to enjoy it from the very first day and for many years to come.
